summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on embedded systems experience spanning bare-metal C/C++ on STM32, embedded Linux deployment on NVIDIA Jetson, and real-time systems design with FreeRTOS. Built firmware and Linux services using UART/I2C communication protocols, interrupt-driven peripheral control, and systemd-managed service administration across robotics and sensor-integration projects. Comfortable moving quickly across new hardware platforms and technical domains, from bare-metal microcontrollers to Linux-based embedded devices.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C communication protocols with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART communication protocols.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS real-time task scheduling with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart, non-root isolation, environment-file config) with static IP networking; configured XRDP for remote administration of the headless embedded Linux Jetson device.
Implemented two-link inverse kinematics on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.
Resolved 11 integration failures across a distributed pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
